rows.name: RecallWins
rows.text: Once a drone is recalled, it does not watch again until it has landed.

rows.name: ReturnsWhenIsolated
rows.text: From any situation a drone can be in, it can always get back to landed; an isolated drone included.

rows.name: GeofenceBreachEndsWatch
rows.text: Once a drone is outside its cleared airspace, it does not watch until it has landed.

rows.name: QuarantinedStaysOut
rows.text: Once a drone is quarantined, it takes no part in coordination until it has been readmitted.

rows.name: PositionDriftHazard
rows.text: Without satellite positioning, a drone's position estimate drifts and its reports place objects in the wrong place.

rows.name: MeshJammingHazard
rows.text: Interference cuts the links between drones, and coordination stalls.

rows.name: MisclassificationHazard
rows.text: A detection is reported as the wrong class, or given a forced class where Unknown was the truth.

rows.name: SensingDegradedUnnoticedHazard
rows.text: A sensor degrades and nobody knows the reports from it are unreliable.

rows.name: StaleTrackHazard
rows.text: A track is shown as current after nothing has seen the object for a while.

rows.name: SpoofedMemberHazard
rows.text: Something that is not one of the drones joins the mesh and takes part in coordination.

rows.name: MixedClassifierVersionsHazard
rows.text: Drones run different classifier versions and classify the same object differently.

rows.name: OperatorOverloadHazard
rows.text: More alerts reach the operator than they can judge, and they accept what is in front of them.

rows.name: MemberCollisionHazard
rows.text: two members sharing the same airspace fail to deconflict their flight paths and risk collision.

rows.name: PrematureDepartureHazard
rows.text: a member leaves its sector for recall or recharge before a handover to a peer completes, leaving a gap in watch.

rows.name: UncoveredMemberLossHazard
rows.text: a member is lost or grounded and the fleet does not redistribute coverage quickly enough, leaving its sector unwatched.

rows.name: UnrelayedIsolationHazard
rows.text: an isolated member finds no peer able to relay for it and drops out of coordination without anyone noticing.

rows.name: GroundLinkSinglePointOfFailureHazard
rows.text:
Because this alternative centralises the deciding half of inter-member coordination at
                     the ground control station, a lost ground link stalls sector handover, recharge rotation,
                     redistribution, deconfliction, relay assignment, track correlation, track handover and
                     admission fleet-wide, even though detection, classification, navigation and local
                     report-holding continue on board. Accepted for this alternative: the trade study's second
                     alternative addresses it by moving at least half of the coordination functions onto the
                     members so they keep settling among themselves without the ground link; the low
                     groundLinkLossAreaUnderWatchShare estimate below states the residual risk this alternative
                     carries instead of mitigating it.
